fields.reasoning: session.message (internal/api/session_message.go typePointer) types only into a session whose status resolves idle and waits on a blocked one, so a blocked report would make the inbox's own next step hang; an idle report keeps the session messageable. The idle report session run writes before a re-prompt, when no Stop hook fired, carries no detail, so a session still being retried never shows as an api-error item. The detail prefix follows session.LimitPausedDetail, which Stallable already excludes; excluding this prefix too keeps the daemon's 20-minute nudge from doubling the item. A new kind rather than stalled says what happened and what to try.
fields.statement: A session left on an API error is recorded as an idle hook report whose detail starts 'stopped on an API error: ' and the error text; rhiza inbox lists it as an item of the new kind api-error with rhiza session message as the next step; it never counts as stalled, and the session's next hook report clears it

fields.acceptance: A Go test in internal/api/session_run_apierror_test.go (go test -trimpath ./internal/api/ -run SessionRunAPIError) with a fake adapter, a fake process, a fake message sender and the poll and backoff shortened: an autonomous session whose new transcript ends in an API error gets one message naming the error after the first backoff and none before it; its record, last reported working by the hook, holds an idle hook report with no 'stopped on an API error: ' detail before each send, and inboxItems over that run lists no api-error item for the session while retries remain; an assistant line written during the backoff cancels the send; three consecutive API errors give three messages and a fourth gives none, with the record left on 'stopped on an API error: ' and the error text; an error, a recovered assistant line, then a new error re-prompts again; an owner-attended session's API error gives no message and the record at once; a usage-limit line gives no message and the usage-limit pause still happens; an API error in the transcript before this start's base gives nothing. Touches internal/api/session_run.go, internal/api/session_run_apierror.go, internal/api/session_run_apierror_test.go
fields.statement: While its agent runs, `rhiza session run` watches the session's transcript past where this start began, on the usage-limit poll; when it ends in an API error (adapter-reads-api-error) in a session an autonomous run launched, it waits the retry policy's backoff, then, if no later assistant line has appeared, records a plain idle hook report, with no 'stopped on an API error: ' detail so the inbox lists nothing while retries remain, unless the status already resolves idle and sends the session, through session.message, a message naming the error and telling it to carry on where it left off; it re-prompts at most 3 consecutive errors, and on the fourth, or on the first in an owner-attended run's session, it re-prompts nothing and records the session for the inbox (inbox-lists-api-error-sessions)
